name: Honda CBR600F4 / F4i
engine: 599 cc liquid-cooled inline four, carbs (F4) or fuel injected (F4i)
intro: The last of Honda's all-round CBR600F line. The 1999-2000 F4 has carbs, the 2001-2006 F4i is fuel injected.

add.title: Listen for cam chain tensioner rattle
add.instructions: Start it cold and listen at the right side of the head. A rattle that fades as it warms can be the cam chain tensioner.
add.reason: Owners have reported repeated cam chain tensioner trouble on these bikes.

G: 1999-2000 F4 bikes have carbs. 2001-2006 F4i bikes are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Cam chain tensioner
known.what: An owner complaint to NHTSA reports ongoing cam chain tensioner trouble on a 2002 F4i.
